say:3:1321303001:1.text: Madam Gerda, is something wrong? You've been staring at the hot spring for quite a while. Is there something wrong with the water?
say:3:1321303001:1.source_cn: 老板娘，你遇到什么棘手的事了吗？满满看你一直盯着温泉发...

say:4:1321303002:1.text: Hmm? Oh no, the hot spring's just fine! The Frozen Paw's spring water flows straight from deep underground, so the quality and temperature are perfectly fine. I was just thinking about some... business matters.
say:4:1321303002:1.source_cn: 啊，不是的。白熊旅店的温泉水来源于地下，不用担心水质和...

say:5:1321303003:1.text: Is the inn not doing well?!
say:5:1321303003:1.source_cn: 旅店的经营状况不好吗？

say:6:1321303004:1.text: Haha, not in the slightest! With all the travelers pouring into Cedartown, we're busier than ever.
say:6:1321303004:1.source_cn: 哈哈，最近雪松镇来了这么多游客，怎么可能不好？

say:7:1321303005:1.text: If anything, I've got the opposite problem—we're running short on ingredients for our famous dishes!
say:7:1321303005:1.source_cn: 刚好相反，就是因为客人太多，才导致了现在的食材短缺问题。

say:8:1321303006:1.text: Oh no! Does that mean everyone's going hungry?!
say:8:1321303006:1.source_cn: 食材短缺……？！那大家岂不是都要饿肚子？！

say:9:1321303007:1.text: Oh, darling, nothing so dramatic! The basics are covered. It's just that some of the rarer ingredients are out of stock, so we've had to tweak the menu a little. But don't worry, no one's going to starve!
say:9:1321303007:1.source_cn: 只是一部分产量稀少的食材暂时买不到，不少本地经典菜肴没...

say:10:1321303008:1.text: But it got me wondering... What if I could raise fish right here in the hot spring? It might help with the ingredient shortage.
say:10:1321303008:1.source_cn: 我刚才在想，温泉里能不能养鱼呢？要是可以的话，应该能暂...

say:11:1321303009:1.text: You guys are adventurers, aren't you? Ever heard of such a thing?
say:11:1321303009:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，你们见多识广，有没有见过或者听说过类似的事？

choice_prompt:12:1321303009.text: You guys are adventurers, aren't you? Ever heard of such a thing?
choice_prompt:12:1321303009.source_cn: 亲爱的，你们见多识广，有没有见过或者听说过类似的事？

say:13:1321303010:1.text: I've never heard of any fish living in hot springs before...
say:13:1321303010:1.source_cn: 我也没听说过类似的事……

say:14:1321303013:1.text: Anyway, let's give it a try! There's a good chance some fish could adapt. Warmer water might even be better for them.
say:14:1321303013:1.source_cn: 总之可以试试看！温泉的水温也没有太高，应该有不少鱼都可...

say:15:1321303014:1.source_cn: 那太好了！既然你们都这样说，看来的确有一定的可行性呢。

say:16:1321303015:1.text: Well then, sweetheart, how about lending me a hand? If you could catch a few live fish—maybe <style="highlight">two types</style>, one from <style="highlight">icy waters</style> and one from somewhere <style="highlight">warmer</style>—I'd be ever so grateful.
say:16:1321303015:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，你们方不方便帮我抓一些活鱼或者活虾？最好能从<...

say:17:1321303016:1.text: And if one of them thrives in the spring, I'll whip up a special Cedartown delicacy just for you. What do you say?
say:17:1321303016:1.source_cn: 作为回报，如果能找到适合养在温泉里的鱼，我就用它做一道...

say:18:1321303017:1.text:
A Cedartown delicacy?!
Say no more, just leave it to Sir Chippy!
say:18:1321303017:1.source_cn: 美食——！！\n没问题，满满一定完成任务！

say:21:1321303011:1.text: Oh, maybe! Tropical fish thrive in warmer waters. They might adapt to the hot spring environment.
say:21:1321303011:1.source_cn: 嗯，大部分热带鱼都喜欢温暖的水域，应该也能待在温泉里。

say:22:1321303012:1.text: Not necessarily! Glacial fish are used to cold water, but that doesn't mean they can't handle warmer conditions.
say:22:1321303012:1.source_cn: 不一定哦。冰河鱼只是适应了寒冷的水温，但不代表它们只能...

choice:12:2:3.source_cn: 冰河里的鱼肯定不行吧……
